common.tagline: Quartz Stone Sanitaryware & Kitchen Sink Manufacturer
meta.title: MOOSUN | Quartz Wash Basins · Kitchen Sinks · Laundry Sinks Manufacturer
meta.desc: MOOSUN Sanitaryware Co., Ltd. — Hubei's largest quartz stone kitchen & bath factory. Specializing in quartz wash basins, kitchen sinks, laundry sinks, and aluminum cabinets. 1M+ sets/year, CE/FDA/cUPC/ISO certified, exported to 30+ countries.
hero.desc: MOOSUN Sanitaryware Co., Ltd. is located in Xiaochi Lingang Industrial Park, Huangmei County, Hubei Province. Covering 166 mu (110,000 m²) with 120,000 m² of factory buildings, it is the largest quartz stone kitchen & bath manufacturer in the region. We produce quartz wash basins, kitchen sinks, laundry sinks, and all-aluminum cabinets. CE, FDA, cUPC, and ISO certified, exported to 30+ countries across Europe and the Americas.
products.label: Core Products
products.title: Quartz Stone Kitchen & Bath Collection
products.desc: Made from 80-92% high-purity quartz sand with food-grade resin, formed under high temperature and pressure. Mohs hardness 6-7, non-porous, crack-resistant, seamlessly integrated, and built to last.
products.p1.name: Quartz Integrated Basin
products.p1.desc: Seamless one-piece molding of countertop and basin — no joints, no seams. Beautiful and effortless to clean. Full size and color customization available, compatible with various bathroom vanities.
products.p2.name: Quartz Undermount Sink
products.p2.desc: Undermount installation for a seamless countertop look. Easy to clean with no dead corners — ideal for home bathrooms, hotel projects, and commercial spaces.
products.p3.name: Quartz Kitchen Sink
products.p3.desc: High-hardness quartz stone material, scratch and impact resistant. Single and double bowl designs available to meet modern kitchen needs.
products.p4.name: Quartz Laundry Sink
products.p4.desc: Large-capacity deep basin design, sturdy and durable. Perfect for balconies, laundry rooms, and utility areas — balancing practicality with aesthetics.
products.p5.name: Bathroom Vanity Set
products.p5.desc: Quartz stone countertop basin paired with all-aluminum bathroom cabinet. Moisture-proof and rust-resistant with a modern minimalist style. Multiple color schemes available.
products.p6.name: All-Aluminum Cabinet Series
products.p6.desc: All-aluminum alloy cabinet body — zero formaldehyde, waterproof, moisture-proof, fire-resistant, and durable. Paired with quartz stone countertops for a healthy kitchen.
factory.label: Factory Strength
factory.title: Hubei's Largest Quartz Stone Kitchen & Bath Manufacturing Base
factory.desc1: MOOSUN Sanitaryware is located at No. 4888 Wuchu Avenue, Xiaochi Lingang Industrial Park, Huangmei County, Hubei Province. Established in 2017, the factory covers 166 mu of land with 120,000 m² of standardized workshop space — the largest quartz stone kitchen & bath manufacturing enterprise in the Xiaochi region.
factory.desc2: Our factory is equipped with Italian CNC machining centers, fully automated polishing lines, and climate-controlled curing workshops, with an annual output of over 1 million sets of quartz wash basins, kitchen sinks, and laundry sinks. We support OEM/ODM customization to flexibly meet diverse market demands. Our independently developed PMMA super artificial granite technology has broken the German technology monopoly and earned 51 national patents.

factory.f1.desc: 51 national patents. Independently developed PMMA super artificial granite, breaking the German technology monopoly.

factory.f3.title: Rigorous Quality Control
factory.f3.desc: Every product passes 12 quality tests including heat resistance, impact resistance, and anti-permeation.
factory.f4.title: Flexible Customization
factory.f4.desc: OEM/ODM supported — full customization from color and size to shape for global market needs.

process.label: Our Craft
process.title: 8-Step Process · Patented Technology
process.desc: From raw material selection to finished packaging, every step follows rigorous standards. Our independently developed PMMA super artificial granite technology ensures superior product performance.
process.step1.title: Premium Raw Materials
process.step1.desc: 80-92% high-purity quartz sand with food-grade resin. Strict SiO₂ content and particle distribution testing.
process.step2.title: Precision Batching
process.step2.desc: Quartz sand, resin, and pigments mixed in exact proportions. Computer-controlled batching with <0.1% error.
process.step3.title: Vacuum Pressing
process.step3.desc: High-pressure molding in a vacuum environment, eliminating air bubbles to ensure density and strength.
process.step4.title: Temperature-Controlled Curing
process.step4.desc: 48-hour stepped temperature curing in climate-controlled workshops for enhanced hardness and dimensional stability.
process.step5.title: CNC Precision Machining
process.step5.desc: Italian-imported CNC equipment for cutting, drilling, and edging with ±0.5mm precision.
process.step6.title: Multi-Stage Polishing
process.step6.desc: 5 stages from rough grinding to fine polishing, achieving surface gloss above 85°.
process.step7.title: Quality Testing
process.step7.desc: Piece-by-piece visual inspection, dimensional measurement, impact and heat resistance — 12 checks in total.
process.step8.title: Professional Packaging
process.step8.desc: Custom pearl cotton + reinforced carton + wooden crate bracing for zero-damage long-distance shipping.
